gates.summary: The signed exact-source binding records the Git tree, canonical manifest, final genesis, runtime versions, binary hashes, image identity, and deterministic Linux bundle.
Specification requires corrected activation, transcript, manifest and differential-vector evidence before satisfaction.

The exact final-genesis candidate exercised canonical enrollment, qualification, the height-1440 reward path, state convergence, restart persistence, and replay through the integrated HF17 coordinator.

The frozen 18-bit admission, dynamic 2-of-3 bootstrap quorum, three-round/two-required profile, population ceiling, and reward ratio passed the exact-genesis four-node rehearsal; continuing measurements remain post-launch obligations.

The rehearsal candidate fixes 10% subsidy-only service rewards, actual-issued-subsidy accounting and miner fallback for an empty qualification set; integrated emission, payout and wallet evidence is still missing.
The scoped payment-proof candidate has not received independent cryptographic review.

Same-transaction LMDB commitments, bounded disconnect and canonical startup/deep replay are implemented; process-crash fault injection, full reorg integration and the declared pruning mode remain unproved.

Typed P2P ingress and an embedded rehearsal relay/template policy now provide bounded canonical admission and deterministic template insertion; live canonical service probing, multi-node propagation, DNS-race coverage and sustained-load measurements remain open.

Exact-candidate four-node admission, enrollment, qualification, height-1440 reward convergence, restart persistence and fresh-genesis replay passed; exact-candidate partition/heal and payout-boundary deep-reorg evidence remain open.
Maturity, spend, recipient receipt, rescan, repeated output uniqueness, and reward-fork replacement are not proven on final binaries.
Exact-source Linux binaries, Docker identity, checksums and a deterministic bundle are bound; macOS Apple Silicon and the complete dependency/release matrix remain open.
No independent adversarial review of the integrated hardened protocol exists.
The activation manifest now binds the final-launch genesis, exact source and Linux candidate artifacts, but a signed standalone release manifest and the complete final binary matrix remain open.
